text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Ah!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Found you~âª Heyyy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During training, Fine Motion suddenly 
bolted toward the spectator stands...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. Stop bothering me every five 
seconds...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one sitting in the stands was Air 
Shakurâ a logic-driven Umamusume who had 
debuted before Fine Motion.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh? And here I thought you came just to 
see me, Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huuuh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Were you taking data on me again?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was a reason she said 'again.' She 
had frequently spotted Air Shakur with her 
laptop during training sessions before.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Hiding because you don't wanna do it? 
Or do you need permission first?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's not it! I mean, since we're here, 
we might as well train together!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That way Shakur can gather data more 
efficiently, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
In exchange, the chances of you bothering 
me go up. No thanks.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean giving them a tight hug? Is 
it okay as long as we just talk without 
getting physically entangled?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Oi, you're her Trainer, right? Didn't 
you ever teach her not to get in other 
people's way?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huuuh!? Of course it's a pain in the ass!
choice_data_list: Then why are you collecting data on Fine?
Then why are you collecting data on Fine?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Does there need to be any reason other 
than it being necessary? Accurate numbers 
fundamentally don't lie, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Take this, for example. You know about 
that research linking certain genes to 
distance aptitudes, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Anyone well-versed in racing has heard 
this theory. That the number of genes 
suppressing muscle cells determines an 
Umamusume's optimal distance.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
To read that kind of trend, you need a lot 
of samples. Numbers are king—without 
enough data, there's nothing to talk 
about.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Unlike some romantic out there, I'm not 
obsessed with data.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Everything's predetermined. But where's 
the fun if you just follow the "language 
of God" like a garbage game?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
To hunt down and poke at bugs... no amount 
of data is ever enough.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Particularly the data on that one who's 
clearly different from the rest.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hm? You mean me?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, I wouldn't give a damn. I see 
fluctuations in your data.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's an irregularity not covered by the 
rules. If I take advantage of that...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...That "7 centimeters" might've changed 
too. Though whether the gap shrunk or grew 
is another story.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――"7 centimeters." To Air Shakur, it was 
an abyss of despair.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having won the Satsuki Sho, she ran in the 
Japan Derby with the second crown on the 
line, only to suffer defeat by a mere 7 
centimeters.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, she went on to win the Kikuka 
Sho and become a Double Crown Umamusume, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"‘In the end... it was just proven that 
data can't be overturned.’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I still remember her back as she muttered 
just a single word at the post-race press 
conference and walked away—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Damn it. I said too much.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...What is it? Say something unnecessary 
and I'll crush you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Or is that it? Our deeply compassionate 
Royal Highness wants compensation in 
return for data?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I don't really care about the data. 
Because...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, I just wanted to talk a little 
more, that's all!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Don't need it. Go shoot the breeze with 
your own Trainer or something."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you. ...Keep a proper eye on this 
one, got it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Obviously it means don't just fool 
around doing nothing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
――Letting 'em run "all the way to the end" 
is our job, ain't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Shakur hasn't changed a bit, has she? Her 
way of communicating is quite unique."
choice_data_list: That's what I love about you.
That's what I love about you, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu, so you understand?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's not because of how she acts or 
talks... Ah, of course I love that part of 
her too, though.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Number one is... because she's someone I 
can really look up to, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Even if despair arrives, never stop 
thinking.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"You're so smart and cool. That's what I 
love about you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The words she uses to speak of Air Shakur 
undeniably brim with respect.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What about Air Shakur, on the other hand? 
She seems to have noticed Fine Motion's 
aptitude and is analyzing it, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Particularly the data on that one who's 
clearly different from the rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe she's feeling 'something' beyond 
even that...?"
